_note: Serving stacks (Fernando, 2026-09-27): what the entree is served in (vessel), whether that sits on something (carrier), and what else each one holds. Default is a plate with no carrier, so a tray or large rectangle is never the default. `holds` is the full capacity of each vessel or carrier, the entree (or vessel) included; real sizes are checked too.

plate._why: Fernando 2026-09-27: a plate holds an entree plus up to two small sides.

board._why: An entree plus one side (any size, small ones included) and up to two condiments; real size decides the rest (35 x 20 cm).

_smallSide: A small side is a side served straight on the vessel (a portion) or in a dish no wider than smallSideMaxM. Where a host allows SIDE, small sides count against it too.
